title: The Depths Where Asphalt Dissolves

features.name: the-dissolving-path
features.desc-on-touch: Where the road met water, it chose the water's grammar. Minerals bloom like flowers in the dissolution.

features.name: the-hardened-current
features.desc-on-touch: What was stone here learned to flow; what flowed learned patience. The water carries the memory of geometry.

features.name: the-sediment-descent
features.desc-on-touch: Particles of what the road was now sink through layers of becoming. Each grain carries a coordinate from a place above.

inscription: the road took a long drink and forgot it had anywhere to go

file.name: CrossSection_RiverDepth_Asphalt_Late20thCent.png
file.note: A geological sample showing asphalt aggregate at 14m depth, indistinguishable from river-worn stone, labeled by hand in fading ink: where did the road end and the river begin

exits.label: back up to the current and its memory of form
deeper still, where water forgets it was ever clear
toward the estuary where rivers and roads finally agree
